notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Marath.
Marath has at least three +1/+1 counters.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, choosing to create a 1/1 Elemental token.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Marath's ability.
Resolve both abilities, creating two 1/1 Elemental tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, choosing to put a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Marath's ability.
Resolve both abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Repeat.
